properties.name: Hyde Park
properties.description: A vast royal park with open meadows, a boating lake, and tree-lined paths. Perfect for jogging, picnics, and quiet relaxation away from the city noise.

properties.name: St Thomas Hospital
properties.description: A major NHS teaching hospital on the South Bank offering emergency care, specialist surgery, and outpatient services for the local community.

properties.name: British Museum
properties.description: World-famous museum housing ancient Egyptian mummies, Greek sculptures, and artefacts from across human history spanning two million years.

properties.name: Borough Market
properties.description: One of London's oldest and largest food markets. Vendors sell artisan cheese, fresh bread, street food, and seasonal produce from around the world.

properties.name: Tate Modern
properties.description: A leading contemporary art gallery inside a converted power station. Features modern and avant-garde works by Picasso, Warhol, and Rothko with free entry.

properties.name: Waterloo Station
properties.description: London's busiest railway terminal with national rail connections, the London Underground, and direct Eurostar access to Paris and Brussels.

properties.name: Tower Bridge
properties.description: An iconic Victorian bascule bridge over the River Thames. Visitors can walk across the glass-floored high-level walkways and visit the engine rooms.

properties.name: Southwark Cathedral
properties.description: A medieval Gothic cathedral with a history dating back 1,000 years. Offers daily services, a quiet garden, and hosts regular classical music concerts.

properties.name: Shakespeare's Globe Theatre
properties.description: A faithful reconstruction of the original Elizabethan open-air theatre where Shakespeare performed. Hosts outdoor plays in the original groundling tradition.

properties.name: King's College London
properties.description: A leading research university on the Strand with faculties in medicine, law, science, and humanities. Home to over 30,000 students from 150 countries.

properties.name: St James's Park
properties.description: The oldest of the Royal Parks, offering stunning views of Buckingham Palace across its lake. Famous for its pelicans and beautiful flower beds.

properties.name: Barbican Centre
properties.description: Europe's largest multi-arts venue with a concert hall, cinemas, theatres, art gallery, and restaurants. Home to the London Symphony Orchestra.
